registration_basis: Existing ledger diagnostic was already executed; this is retrospective registration of that unchanged experiment for first Lab export, not fresh OOS preregistration.
sample: ABT: existing fixed ten-company pilot member selected for documented single common security, split history and dividend evidence; no performance-based selection
selection: No QGV ranking or stock selection; one occupied slot of fifteen, other slots cash
execution: Existing ANNUAL_FEBRUARY calendar; prior completed close fixes quantity; next session raw SIP open fills; exit at second annual execution
benchmark: Nominal non-interest-bearing USD cash; explicit diagnostic baseline, not SPY or risk-free market series
dividends: Issuer declared amounts, record and payable dates; ex dates DERIVED under historical FINRA rule, exceptional exchange dates not independently excluded
tried_conditions: One unchanged 10bps-per-side ledger replay; fixed-fill gross path only for cost reconciliation, not a second strategy
metrics: Existing qgv_backtest.performance_metrics: actual-days/365.25 CAGR, daily sample stdev times sqrt(252), daily negative MDD; Sharpe null without measured RF
curve: First month labels the actual initial signal-date NAV=100; later months use last available session, final month ends on actual exit date. Full daily path in private evidence.
